Rashi on Shabbat 137a:10:1.hebrew: ור' יהושע התם - עובד עבודת כוכבים לא עשה מצוה:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:10:1.english: And Rabbi Yehoshua [holds]: There - One who worships idols did not perform a mitzvah.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:11:1.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr>: רב יהודה מתני "פטור", דתניא: אמר <abbr title="רבי מאיר">ר"מ</abbr>: לא נחלקו <abbr title="רבי אליעזר">ר"א</abbr> ורבי יהושע על שהיו לו שני תינוקות, אחד למול <abbr title="ערב שבת">ע"ש</abbr> כו':
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:11:1.english: [This is] the [correct] reading: Rav Yehuda taught "exempt," as it was taught [in a baraita]: Rabbi Meir said: Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua did not disagree regarding [one] who had two babies, one to circumcise on Shabbat eve, etc.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:14:1.hebrew: ה"ג: ורבי יהושע התם לא טריד במצוה, הכא טריד במצוה - טרוד להתעסק במצוה גמורה, שהרי אחד מהם זמנו היום וטרוד לבו למהר ולעשות, ומתוך טרדו טעה ומל את זה שאין בו מצוה כלל:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:14:1.english: This is how we read [the text]: And Rabbi Yehoshua: There, he is not preoccupied with a mitzvah; here, he is preoccupied with a mitzvah - [He is] preoccupied with engaging in a full-fledged mitzvah, since the time [for] one of them is today and his heart is preoccupied with hurrying to perform [it], and out of his preoccupation he erred and circumcised this [other] one, in which there is no mitzvah at all.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:15:1.hebrew: ושכח ומל של ע"ש בשבת שהוא חייב - לקמיה מתרץ לה:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:15:1.english: And he forgot and circumcised the one of Shabbat eve on Shabbat, that he is liable - Further on, [the Gemara] resolves it.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:18:1.hebrew: דלא ניתנה שבת לידחות - שאין לו תינוק שיהא זמנו היום. הלכך, לא היה טרוד היום במצוה, שלא היה מוטל עליו כלום לעשות, ולא היה לו לטעות:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:18:1.english: For Shabbat is not given to be overridden - because he has no infant whose [circumcision] time is today. Therefore, he was not preoccupied today with a mitzvah, as nothing was incumbent upon him to do, and he should not have erred.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:1:1.hebrew: והא סתם ספרא הוא - דבתורת כהנים תניא לה, וסתם ספרא רבי יהודה:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:1:1.english: And is it not an unattributed [teaching of] Sifra - For it is taught in Torat Kohanim, and an unattributed [teaching of] Sifra [is the opinion of] Rabbi Yehuda.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:21:1.hebrew: נולד בין השמשות נימול לט' - שהרי ליום שמיני של מחר הוא נימול, ושמא בין השמשות יום הוא, ונימול לט':
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:21:1.english: [If] he was born at twilight, he is circumcised at nine [days] - For he is circumcised on the eighth day [counted] from the next day, and perhaps twilight is [still] day, and [thus] he is circumcised at nine [days].

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:21:2.hebrew: היה היום ע"ש - א"א למולו בשבת הבאה, דשמא ט' הוא, והויא ליה מילה שלא בזמנה ואינה דוחה שבת, וצריך להמתין עד לאחר השבת שהוא עשירי:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:21:2.english: [If] the day was Shabbat eve - It is impossible to circumcise him on the following Shabbat, for perhaps it is the ninth [day], and it would be a circumcision not at its [appointed] time, which does not override Shabbat, and one must wait until after Shabbat, which is the tenth [day].

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:22:1.hebrew: חל יו"ט להיות אחר השבת - אין מילה שלא בזמנה דוחה אותו, ונימול לי"א:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:22:1.english: [If] a Festival falls after Shabbat - A circumcision that is not at its [proper] time does not override it, and he is circumcised on the eleventh [day].

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:24:1.english: The fever left him - The illness was drawn out from him and left his body.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:26:1.english: Which Luda taught - [Luda is the] name of a Sage.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:26:2.english: The day of his healing is like the day of his birth - We wait for him as [from] the day of his birth.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:26:3.hebrew: מאי לאו - יום הולדו דווקא קאמר, דלא בעינן מעת לעת:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:26:3.english: What, is it not - He is saying "the day of his birth" specifically, that we do not require [waiting] from time to time.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:26:4.hebrew: לא - כיום הולדו דקתני, למיתב ליה ז'; מיהו עדיף יום הבראתו מהא דבעינן מעת לעת, ומהא ליכא למשמע מידי:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:26:4.english: No - [Rather,] "like the day of his birth" that [Luda] taught [means] to give him seven [days]; however, the day of his healing is more stringent than this [i.e., the day of his birth], in that we require [seven complete days] from time to time, and from this [statement] nothing can be inferred.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:28:1.english: Shreds - Strips of flesh that remained from the foreskin.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:28:2.hebrew: עטרה - היא שפה גבוה המקפת את הגיד סביב, וממנה משפע ויורד לראשו:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:28:2.english: Corona - It is a raised rim that surrounds the organ all around, and from it, [the organ] slopes downward to its tip.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:28:3.hebrew: ואינו אוכל בתרומה - אם כהן הוא, דילפינן ביבמות (ד' ע.) שערל אסור בתרומה:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:28:3.english: And he does not eat teruma - If he is a kohen, for we derive in Yevamot (70a) that an uncircumcised man is forbidden [to partake] of teruma.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:29:1.hebrew: ואם היה בעל בשר - שהיה שמן, ונראה בשר שלמעלה מערלתו, לאחר שניטלה ערלה כולה, כאילו אותו בשר חוזר וחופה את הגיד:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:29:1.english: And if he was fleshy - [meaning] that he was fat, and the flesh above his foreskin appears — after the entire foreskin has been removed — as though that flesh goes back and covers the organ.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:29:2.english: He corrects it - And he pares away with a scalpel from that thickness [of flesh].

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:29:3.english: Because of the appearance of the eye - So that he will not appear as an uncircumcised [person].

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:2:1.hebrew: לקדש - מי חטאת, לתת אפר על המים:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:2:1.english: To sanctify - the waters of purification, [meaning] to put ashes on the water.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:2:2.english: Deems a minor fit, and deems a woman unfit - His reason is explained in Tractate Yoma, in the third chapter.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:2:3.english: And [deems] a hermaphrodite [unfit] - Conclude from this that Rabbi Yehuda treats it like a woman.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:4:1.hebrew: ושכח ומל את של אחר השבת בשבת חייב - דטעה בדבר מצוה ולא עשה מצוה הוא, ועבד ליה חבורה שלא לצורך, ובהא אפילו רבי יהושע מודה:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:4:1.english: And he forgot and circumcised the one [to be circumcised] after Shabbat on Shabbat, he is liable - For he [is one who] erred in a matter of a mitzvah and did not perform a mitzvah, and he inflicted a wound unnecessarily; and in this [case], even Rabbi Yehoshua agrees.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:5:1.hebrew: אחד למול בשבת ואחד למול בע"ש ושכח ומל את של ע"ש בשבת ר"א מחייב חטאת - דמילה שלא בזמנה אינה דוחה שבת, ואע"ג דטעה בדבר מצוה — שהיה טרוד באותו של שבת ומתוך כך טעה בזה, ואף בזה עשה מצוה, שהרי ראוי הוא למול אלא שאינו דוחה שבת — ס"ל לר"א טעה בדבר מצוה ועשה מצוה שיש בה חיוב חטאת, חייב. ורבי יהושע פוטר, דס"ל טעה בדבר מצוה ועשה מצוה, פטור:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:5:1.english: One to circumcise on Shabbat and one to circumcise on Shabbat eve, and he forgot and circumcised the one of Shabbat eve on Shabbat, Rabbi Eliezer deems [him] liable [for] a sin-offering - For circumcision not in its [proper] time does not override Shabbat. And even though he erred in [connection with] a mitzvah matter — as he was preoccupied with the one of Shabbat and because of that he erred with this one, and even with this one he performed a mitzvah, since [the child] is fit to be circumcised, except that it does not override Shabbat — Rabbi Eliezer holds [that if] one erred in a mitzvah matter and performed a mitzvah that carries liability for a sin-offering, he is liable. And Rabbi Yehoshua exempts [him], because he holds [that if] one erred in a mitzvah matter and performed a mitzvah, he is exempt.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:6:1.hebrew: רב הונא מתני - במתניתין ברישא, חייב לדברי הכל, כדתנינן לה אנן:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:6:1.english: Rav Huna teaches - In our Mishnah, in the first clause, "liable" according to all [opinions], as we teach it.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:6:2.hebrew: ורב יהודה מתני ברישא פטור - דמוקי לה בשכח ומל את של ע"ש בשבת, ופלוגתא היא בשל אחר השבת בשבת:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:6:2.english: And Rav Yehuda teaches in the first clause, "exempt" - For he establishes it [as referring to one who] forgot and circumcised [an infant whose eighth day was] Shabbat eve on Shabbat, and the dispute is regarding [an infant whose eighth day is] after Shabbat [whom he circumcised] on Shabbat.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:7:1.hebrew: שהוא חייב - דאע"ג דטריד במצוה וטעה בה, כיון דלאו מצוה, שעדיין לא הגיע זמנו למול, חייב:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:7:1.english: That he is liable - For even though he was preoccupied with a mitzvah and erred in it, since [it is] not a mitzvah, as his time to be circumcised has not yet arrived, he is liable.

Rashi on Shabbat 137a:9:1.hebrew: אלא מע"ז - שהוקשו כל חטאות שבתורה לחטאת ע"ז, דכתיב: "תורה אחת יהיה לכם" וגו', בפרשת שלח לך אנשים גבי קרבן ע"ז:
Rashi on Shabbat 137a:9:1.english: Only from idolatry - For all sin-offerings in the Torah were compared to the sin-offering for idolatry, as it is written: "There shall be one law for you," etc., in the Torah portion of Shelach Lecha Anashim, regarding the offering for idolatry.

Tosafot on Shabbat 137a:2:1.hebrew: הזכר ולא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס - תימה לרבי, דבפרק אלו מומין (בכורות דף מב.) גבי בכור מצריך "הזכר" "הזכרים" למעוטי טומטום ואנדרוגינוס; משמע התם דמהזכר לחודיה לא הוה ממעט לה, והכא ממעטין ליה מהזכר לחודיה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 137a:2:1.english: "The male" — and not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite - This is puzzling to my teacher, for in the chapter [entitled] Eilu Mumin (Bekhorot 42a), regarding a firstborn [animal], [the Gemara] requires [both] "the male" [and] "the males" to exclude a tumtum and a hermaphrodite; [this] implies there that from "the male" alone it would not have excluded them, whereas here we exclude them from "the male" alone.
